notes_for_editor: No build date, staffing, fire or removal record found in the sources read. The 1952 survey description is the only build-era source. Brief height 22.9 m is about 75 ft converted. Brief status 'unknown' left as is: neither the survey note nor the trail page confirms the cage stands today. The onX access note relies on user reports, so it is weak. The Mena and Oden lookout list on ARGenWeb does not mention Eagle Mountain. A Ouachita National Forest district contact could settle the current status. Fact-check 2026-10-21: story wording narrowed to what the page shows: one dated user report (Jun 08, 2025) and user-submitted status reports; the 'in places' detail was removed.
